body.name: Initial-absorption observational-equivalence pair
body.construction: Mix \(4/5\) of \(\omega^\star\) with an all-exit path of probability \(1/5\) in each cohort. In \(P^A\), allocate all added mass to type \(1\); in \(P^B\), allocate it to type \(2\), leaving every type-specific transition kernel fixed.
